parts.html: The K-44 kitchen model is a contemporary L-shaped kitchen in a minimalist style, combining a calm greige palette with warm wood-effect surfaces and stone-inspired finishes.

The lower cabinetry and tall units have a light grey-beige appearance, while the central upper cabinet row introduces a muted grey-brown wood texture. This combination gives the kitchen warmth without compromising the clean geometry and restrained character associated with minimalism.

The worktop and backsplash feature a stone-effect decor with light veining. The standard countertop itself is chipboard-based, so the stone appearance refers to the decorative surface rather than natural stone.
Layout and dimensions
K-44 uses an L-shaped configuration, allowing cabinetry and working surfaces to extend along two adjoining walls.
The total linear length is 5.3 meters, with standard dimensions of 5.3 × 2.5 × 0.6 m.
The tall cabinet block provides space for integrated appliances and additional storage, while the central and corner sections form the main preparation and sink areas.
A separate kitchen island is not included in the standard configuration.
Cabinet materials
One of the notable features of K-44 is the use of different materials for the upper and lower fronts.
The lower cabinet fronts are made from acrylic board based on MDF, creating a smooth contemporary surface.
The upper fronts are laminated chipboard and, in the visual concept, use a wood-effect finish.
The cabinet structure is 18 mm laminated chipboard.
This combination allows the kitchen to retain a practical construction while introducing visual contrast through different textures.
Worktop and backsplash
The standard countertop is chipboard-based.
The visualization uses a warm stone-effect finish with light veining, coordinated with the wall panel behind the working area.
Alternative worktop materials can be selected as optional upgrades, ranging from more budget-friendly solutions to premium specifications.
Hardware and storage
The standard K-44 specification includes Muller Profi Line hinges with soft-close.
Pull-out elements use Muller Box Profi Line drawer systems.
A cargo storage system is included as standard, providing additional accessible storage for food and kitchen essentials.
Cabinet handles are included.
Lift mechanisms are not part of the standard specification.
Built-in appliances
K-44 is designed for built-in household appliances.
Tall cabinet sections can accommodate appliances such as an oven and microwave, while the final appliance layout can be adapted to individual room dimensions and project requirements.
Built-in appliance compatibility does not mean the appliances themselves are automatically included in the standard furniture package.
Additional equipment
Upon request, the kitchen can also be equipped with a sink, tap, extractor hood, plumbing fixtures, and household appliances.
Integrated lighting can be added separately and is calculated according to the selected lighting system and kitchen configuration.
Customization
Although K-44 is offered as a serial kitchen model, it can be adapted to the specific dimensions and requirements of the room.
Cabinet dimensions, tall-unit arrangement, appliance positions, storage organization, and finishes can be adjusted during individual planning.

Clients can also choose more functional furniture hardware and alternative materials ranging from budget-friendly to premium. These are optional upgrades and are specified separately from the standard configuration.

Decor: Solid-color base specification with wood accents in the visual concept
DUMSKAYA DESIGN, based in Bratislava, Slovakia, provides kitchen design, manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation services in Bratislava and Vienna.
